remarks:
**A GREAT OPPORTUNITY TO START OR GROW YOUR REAL ESTATE PORTFOLIO!** Welcome to 7 South Ryan Street, a spacious two-unit property in the heart of South Buffalo! Whether you're purchasing your first investment property, looking to offset your living expenses with rental income, or expanding an established portfolio, this property offers an excellent opportunity.

Featuring two generously sized 3-bedroom, 1-bath apartments, this approximately 2,244-square-foot double offers flexible living arrangements and attractive rental potential. Both apartments feature spacious layouts filled with natural light, comfortable living areas, and porches that provide additional space to relax and unwind. Additional highlights include a full basement and off-street parking.

For those looking to get started in real estate investing, the two-unit configuration offers the possibility of living in one apartment while collecting rental income from the other. Experienced investors will appreciate the desirable three-bedroom layouts, established rental configuration, and opportunities to make improvements and enhance long-term value.

Conveniently situated in South Buffalo, with easy access to local restaurants, shopping, parks, and major roadways, this property offers accessibility and everyday convenience. Whether you're looking for your first income-producing property or your next addition to an investment portfolio, **7 South Ryan Street is an opportunity worth exploring!**
